reports.title: Venture Global Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Our updated guidance for 2026 is as follows:
•Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA1 guidance for the full year 2026 is $10.0 billion - $10.3 billion.

◦As noted in previous quarters, changes in natural gas prices, both domestic and international, could impact Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance. We assume a fixed liquefaction fee range of $21.00/MMBtu - $22.00/MMBtu for our remaining unsold cargos in 2026 in support of our guidance, reflecting market forward prices and recently executed cargo sales.
◦+/- $1.00/MMBtu change in fixed liquefaction fees will impact our full year 2026 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA by $20 million - $30 million.
•We expect to export 152 - 154 cargos from the Calcasieu Project and 357 - 364 cargos from the Plaquemines Project in 2026.
